rows.en:
My name is Akemi Iwashita.
Class 3-A.
...{a}.
Do you have a moment?
I'd like you to turn to me and give me a sweet little smile.{p}Just for an instant is enough.
Smile
I won't do that
I'll smile if you tell me why

Yes, a lovely smile, just like that...
...Thank you.
I must have startled you, saying something so strange out of nowhere.
I'm sorry.
It's just that something caught my interest...{p}

My, there's no need to be so bashful.
I really do think you're cute.{p}Naturally, you have a sweetheart, don't you?
I do
I don't
...Shall I introduce you to someone?
Yes, please introduce me to someone!
I'll pass, thank you
Hmm, what should I do...?

...Really?
There's no need to be shy about it...{p}Or is there someone you like, perhaps?
That's right
No, there's no one like that

Is that so?
Then I suppose you don't want a sweetheart just yet?{p}

Heh heh heh...
That's so like you, {a}.
Don't worry.
A girl like you will find someone wonderful soon enough.
Someone who will love you more than anyone else in this world.{p}

No matter what...
No matter what happens...
Someone who is always by your side, protecting you and you alone.
Forever and ever, for all eternity...
...I had a sweetheart like that too.
It was back before I started high school.{p}

I...
I was supposed to be married the moment I graduated from high school.{p}

Heh heh heh...
There was someone I'd been promised to since the day I was born.{p}

Some people say, 'A fiancé chosen by your parents? Really...', but none of that mattered to us in the least.
We fell in love at first sight, the very moment we met.
How they came to meet means nothing to lovers bound by fate.
I was longing for the day I would wear a wedding dress for Yuya.{p}

...But you see,
our parting came all of a sudden.
It was three years ago.
Yuya was sent off to study at a school abroad.
On the day he left...{p}

...Yes.
I didn't go to the airport to see him off.
The shock of our sudden parting had made me ill.
The car carrying him grew smaller and smaller as it headed for the airport.
He leaned out of the window and kept waving, on and on...
That was the last I ever saw of him.
The news of the accident came about an hour later.{p}

Don't you remember...?
Three years ago, on the road to the airport, there was that massive chain-reaction pileup that left so many dead and injured, remember?
The car he was in got caught up in that crash.
It was a truly horrific accident.
More than thirty people were killed...
And Yuya's name was among them.

...He was dead.
Tell me, {a}...{p}If you lost the one you love most... could you go on living?
Yes, I could go on living
I'm not so sure I could

...I see. So you're a strong person.
I envy you...
Me, I'm hopeless.
I couldn't find the slightest joy in living in a world without Yuya.{p}

Yuya is coming back to me...
He opens the front door, walks down the hall, climbs the stairs, and stops outside my room.
And then he knocks softly on the door...{p}

...That was when I woke up.
"Yuya...?"
I murmured into the darkness, but no answer came.
In my vision, still warped by fever after waking, he was nowhere to be seen.
I was so sad...
So lonely...
I closed my eyes again,
praying that I might at least meet him in my dreams...{p}

I lay dozing on my bed, wrapped in that dusky gloom.
Before me was the familiar door.
...Yes, it was my own room, after all.
Of course it was familiar...
On the other side of that door, I could sense someone.
...Someone was there!
But someone... it could only be him!
Strange, isn't it?
I felt an odd certainty.
...He had come back.
Back to me, just as he promised...
That's what I believed, without the slightest doubt or fear.
<Yuya...?>
I sat up and called out softly.
And then...
<Akemi...
It's me. I've come back.
Won't you open the door?>
The answer from the other side of the door was Yuya's voice, without a doubt.
I could never mistake the voice of the one I love, could I?
...The voice went on.
<That's right.
Akemi... I promised you, didn't I?
That I'd be sure to come back to you...
Hurry, open the door.>
Of course, I did.
I wanted to see Yuya's face as soon as I could.
On unsteady legs I rose and flung the door wide open.{p}

For an instant, I thought I glimpsed Yuya's shy smile in the darkness...
The moment I felt his gaze upon me, a violent headache seized me.
My vision lurched and warped in a rush, and everything went pitch black at once.
<Akemi...
I'll never leave you again.
I'll stay by your side forever and protect you...>
His words echoed in the depths of my fading consciousness.
When I next came to, Yuya was nowhere to be seen.{p}

But you see, I was certain.
Yuya had come back to me...
...Well?
{a}...{p}Can you believe a story like this?
I can believe it
I can't believe it
I see... you believe me.{p}

Heh heh heh...
Thank you.
How kind you are, {a}.
Even my own mother wouldn't believe me...
But I'm glad.
Glad that you believe me, {a}.{p}

Spirits hate having their existence denied, you know.
More than anyone, they want people to notice that they exist.
Yuya is the same.
Normally he wouldn't do anything to harm people...
But if you dismiss him in a single word, as a 'dream' or an 'illusion', he gets terribly angry.{p}

"You only saw an illusion like that because you think of nothing but Yuya, don't you?"
My mother said that and didn't believe in him one bit, and one day she vanished from my life.
She divorced my father.
...And they had been such a loving couple, too.
A classmate who asked me out on a date, never noticing him, suddenly died.
On the railroad tracks, in the dead of night...
...They say it was suicide, but I have my doubts.
There are plenty of others, too.
The classmate who was cruel to me went missing...
Oh, yes...
Just recently, there was a boy who asked me to go out with him.
He was, if I remember right, a second-year...{p}

......Just as Iwashita got that far,
"Ah...!"
someone let out a small cry.
"What's wrong?"
"Just now..."
He had gone pale and was staring fixedly at the window.
Then, slowly, he spoke.
"Just now... someone fell past the window."
"Whaaat?!★"
"It's true.
I... I looked right into his eyes.
His face was all twisted like this, his eyes bulging wide open, his mouth open like he wanted to say something...
...That was Yoshino from Class 2-F!"
The air in the room pulled taut, and every eye turned to the window at once.{p}

It looks like someone jumped...
...What should I do?{p}It's a little scary, but maybe I should look down...
Look down
Have someone else look instead

I got up from my chair and crept toward the window, step by careful step.
Slowly I opened it and timidly poked my head out.{p}

...But below the window there was no body, not even a trace of blood.
It was getting dark outside, but I could tell that much.
...Huh, there's nothing down there.
I let out a sigh of relief.
Then...
"Well, {a}?
Do you see anything...?"
It was Iwashita who called to me from inside.
"No, I don't see anything unusual.
Couldn't you have been mistaken?"
"No way...!"
The boy who had cried out earlier came running over.
He grabbed the window frame and leaned far out to peer down.
But...
"...That's weird.
I was sure I saw it..."
...It seemed he couldn't see anything either.
"You didn't see anything?
...What a pity.
Well then, why don't you hurry back to your seats?
I'm going to continue my story."{p}
At Iwashita's urging, we closed the window and returned to our seats.{p}

"Now, where was I...?"
Iwashita murmured, then giggled softly as if something had come back to her.{p}

Yoshino's name came up just now, didn't it...?
That boy once gave me a love letter.{p}

Heh heh heh heh...
Even though I have Yuya as my sweetheart.
Of course, I turned him down.
I told him I already have a sweetheart...{p}

But Yoshino just wouldn't give up.
"You're lying!
There's no way you have a boyfriend☆"
...he said, and he kept pestering me.
Just then...
I felt something sway softly behind me.
Ah, Yuya is angry...
That's what I thought.
So I just let Yoshino be.
Because I knew that before long, Yuya's wrath would destroy him...
And I was right.
Yoshino jumped from the roof of the school building.
He left no note, nothing at all.
Well, if I had to give a reason, I suppose they'd call it the shock of a broken heart?
That was just three days ago...{p}

Heh heh heh heh...
He jumped from right above this very window.
Heh heh heh heh...
What appeared outside the window just now may have been Yoshino's ghost, killing himself over and over again.
Do you pity him...?
But you mustn't feel sorry for him.
It's Yoshino's own fault for making Yuya angry.{p}

...Tell me, {a}.
A man like Yuya is the finest sweetheart there is.
True love means the kind of love that exists between us.{p}Isn't it wonderful?
It sweeps me off my feet
It's kind of scary
It's nothing special

Every time a boy who comes near me, or a classmate who gives me trouble, meets with misfortune, I feel his love.
It has always been that way...
And it always will be...
{a}...?
If you find it scary, then be careful not to make Yuya angry.
My beloved sweetheart, who stands right behind me...{p}

Heh, do be careful.
Careful not to anger me, or to trouble me...
Heh heh heh...
Well, that's the end of my story.
Whose turn is it next, I wonder...?{p}

My, is that any way to treat an upperclassman?
What an unlovable child.{p}

I can't believe a girl like you is popular with the boys.
Or perhaps...
your attitude changes when it's a boy doing the asking.
Somehow I don't feel like talking anymore.{p}

...Oh, are you flustered now?
Heh heh heh, you'd be in trouble if you couldn't hear about the seven wonders, wouldn't you?
Fine.
You needn't smile for me.
I've completely lost any wish to talk...
Would you hurry along to the next person?{p}

Heh heh heh...
The truth is, quite a few boys are fond of you.
Those boys are always telling me,
"{b} {a} in Class 1-E has the best smile!"
...I hear it from them all the time, you see...
To tell the truth, I was looking forward to meeting you today.
...Well?{p}Will you smile for me?
returns: 63:3618: RETURN - quote framing repeats 'always' ('Those boys are always telling me' ... 'I hear it from them all the time'); source is one sentence split around the quote. Accurate, but editorial may smooth the split.

rows.en: Smile
I won't do that

Yes, a sweet smile, just like that...
...Thank you.
Heh heh heh...
It was a lovely smile, just as the rumors said.{p}

Heh heh, just as I thought...
You're so very pretty, after all.
Men would never leave you alone, would they?
Heh heh heh...
But I'm sure a great many people will be disappointed.
It seems lots of them think you're still available.
...Not that it's anything for you to worry about.
The only one you need to think about is your beloved sweetheart...
Heh heh heh...
If you call someone your sweetheart, then you must love that person, mustn't you?
It would be strange otherwise.
You can't call someone you don't love your 'sweetheart.'
Isn't that right?{p}

Tell me, {a}...
Are you sure you can go on loving that sweetheart?
Whatever may come...{p}Whatever may happen...
Yes, I am
No, I'm not

I see...
That's wonderful.
I was once just like you.
I was asked the very same question, and I answered just as you did, without hesitation.
...I had a sweetheart like that too.
The two of us, always together...
Forever and ever...
Even if we were torn apart, he would always come back to the one he loved.
Yes...
Even if he died...
Heh, that was before I even started high school.{p}

Oh my, you sound rather unsure.
It must be because the two of you don't truly love each other from the heart.
Perhaps you haven't met your real destined partner yet...
...Don't be disappointed.
Two people meeting is a chance of one in hundreds of millions, after all.
Heh, it's all right.
I'm sure you'll meet someone wonderful.
Someone who will love you more than anyone else in this world...{p}

Let me see...
How about Takashima from Class 3-C?
The intellectual, composed sort...{p}He's always in the library.
I'd like to go out with him
...Pass

...No?
Then how about Morishita from Class 3-B?
He's the ace of the handball club.
If you hear the sound of a ball on the field early in the morning, you can be sure it's him.{p}
Heh heh heh...{p}He's terribly devoted to his practice.
I'd like to go out with him
...Pass

...Oh, you don't care for sportsmen either?
I understand.
You'd prefer a grown man, much, much older than you.
...In that case, the target has to be a teacher, of course.{p}

Heh heh heh...
My recommendation would be Mr. Kawaguchi, the art teacher.
He isn't very sociable, but he's what you might call an artist...{p}I'm sure you'll be moved when you see him at work on a painting.
I'd like to go out with him
...Pass

Oh, you don't care for teachers either?
Who else is there, I wonder?
...I know!
Sumiyoshi would be good.
He's in the same year as you, {a}, so I think you'd get along. Now which class was he in again...?
I'd like to go out with him
...Pass

Heh heh heh...
There's no need to worry.
You'll find someone wonderful soon enough.
Someone who will love you more than anyone else in this world.{p}

I understand.
So you want to go out with Takashima.{p}

Heh heh heh...
He's quite a catch.
If there's anything you don't understand in class or in your homework, you should have him teach you.
He explains things very patiently.
Yes, he's terribly smart.
After all, he's been attending this school for a very long time.
Heh heh heh...
When Takashima was a student, the war was on, so he could hardly study at all.
He died in an air raid, without ever getting to read the books he loved.
He wanted to study more...
Because that regret stayed behind, he still appears in the library.
Even now that he's become a ghost.......... you see.{p}

Oh, what's the matter?
{a}, your face has gone white as a sheet.
Were you shocked to learn he's a ghost?
But surely you won't turn him down just because he's a ghost?{p}

That won't do.
You're the one who said you wanted to go out with him, {a}!
I'll never forgive you if you turn him down now.
Besides... I've already called him here.{p}

He should be arriving here any moment now.
Three more meters...
Two meters...
One meter...
Now he's reached the door.
Slowly, he raises his hand..........

"Listen, he's calling for you.
{a}...{p}Why don't you open the door for him?"
Open it
Don't open it
Urged on by Iwashita's voice, I got up from my chair.{p}

It wasn't as if I seriously believed there was a ghost on the other side of the door...
...but still, I was a little scared.
"Come now, hurry up and open it for him."
Iwashita's voice sounded delighted...
I timidly reached out and took a firm grip on the knob.
Then I slowly turned it...
...Here goes!
I pulled back with all my might.{p}

The door flew open.
"...Eek!"{p}

Standing on the other side of the door was a skeleton in tattered clothes.
When it met my gaze, it clattered its teeth and laughed.
"..........☆"
I was too shocked and terrified to make a sound.
I just stared and stared into the skeleton's gaping eye sockets.{p}

Then the skeleton turned into a kind of mist and vanished.
As if it were seeping into my body...{p}

The moment I thought that, my shoulders suddenly grew heavy.
...Wh-what is this★
Every cell in my body had sensed an invisible intruder and was flashing danger signals.
Had I been possessed by that skeleton?{p}

"Heh heh heh...
{a}, the two of you make such a lovely couple."
Even Iwashita's gleeful voice sounded far away, as if it were echoing.
It was hard even to stay on my feet...{p}

I closed the door and made my way back to my seat on unsteady feet.
I didn't have a fever, yet my head was so foggy I couldn't think straight.{p}

"My, my, worn out already...
Well, he's sucking out your life force, so it can't be helped.
But at this rate, I wonder how many more hours your life will last.
Heh heh heh...
If only there were a candle that could measure your lifespan."{p}

"{a}...?"
Iwashita's voice echoed through my hazy mind like static.
"Now, let's move on to the next story.
The sixth story is next.
I wonder who'll be telling it...?"
...That's right.
While there was still some of my life's candle left, I had to hear every story...
I had to hurry and choose the next person...{p}

"You're not opening it?
...Don't tell me you're going to refuse?
I told you that wouldn't do!"
Iwashita rose from her seat and strode right up to me.
Then she yanked my arm and forced me to my feet.
"Now, open it.
You're the one who said you wanted to go out with him, you hear me!"{p}

I understand.
So you want to go out with Morishita.
His gallant figure chasing the ball in the fresh breeze...
And after a bit of sport, you bring him a snack while he wipes away his sweat.
...Doesn't that sound lovely?
Getting up early will be a little hard, but do your best to keep bringing him snacks.
If you do, I'm sure he'll be delighted.
"I just want to work up a good, clean sweat at practice.
It'd be the best if I had a sweetheart cheering me on."
He told me that once.
With a dazzling, refreshing smile.
...Yes, you'd never believe he was a dead man.
Oh, I'm sorry.
I haven't told you yet, have I?
Morishita died in an accident three years ago.{p}
Of course, if you just call him a ghost, that's all there is to it, but...{p}

I understand.
So you want to go out with Mr. Kawaguchi.
Yes, it'll be fine.
I don't think anyone will stand in the way of your love.{p}

After all, Mr. Kawaguchi is already dead.
Didn't you know?
He killed himself in the art prep room over the last spring break.
He slit his throat beside a canvas smeared with bright red paint.
...Oh my, {a}, your face has gone white as a sheet.
Are you scared...?
Because he's a ghost...?
It's too late to turn him down now.
I won't allow it!{p}
As she said this, Iwashita stared at me, her eyes glittering with an ugly light.{p}
Before I knew it, her hand was gripping a box cutter.

Click-click-click...
With a grating sound, the silver blade slid out.
...I have to run!
I knew it, but I only grew more frantic, and my body wouldn't obey me.
My hands and my feet were frozen in place, stuck in the pose of sitting in my chair.
...Why?
All I did was want a sweetheart. Why is this happening to me?
Iwashita gently laid a hand on my shoulder...
and whispered in a kind voice.{p}

"It's all right.
It'll be over in a moment...
You'll be with Mr. Kawaguchi very soon.
It only hurts for an instant."
As her lukewarm breath brushed over me, a sweet scent drifted up...
...the scent of a flower the color of blood.
"This is how I got to meet him, too.
I'm so glad I've made a friend..."{p}
With that, Iwashita raised the box cutter high.{p}

Her throat split wide open, and bright red blood came gushing out of it.
...Ah, a bright red flower.
A flower of bright red blood is blooming...

I felt heat along the side of my neck.
But that, too, lasted only an instant.{p}

Because the next moment, a spray of bright red blood was bursting from my neck too...
<Red...
The bright red color of blood...!
The color of the flowers I always wanted...☆>
As my consciousness slipped away...{p}
The last thing I heard was the shrill, convulsive laughter of a man whose voice I didn't recognize...........{p}

All right.
You want to go out with Sumiyoshi.
He's such a pure-hearted, innocent boy.
I think you and he would make a perfect couple, {a}.
Let's see...
If there's any obstacle, it's just one thing...
The fact that he's a ghost, I suppose.
You see, he died in an accident right after the entrance ceremony.
The first time I met him...
Sumiyoshi was standing at the school gate, peering inside the whole time.
I'd like to go in...
But would I get in trouble...?
...That was the feeling he gave off.
So I called out to him.
"Why not just walk right in?"
...like that.{p}

You seem unsure.
Maybe you don't need a sweetheart just yet, {a}.
Heh heh heh...
There's no need to worry.
You'll find someone wonderful soon enough.
Someone who will love you more than anyone else in this world.{p}

Heh heh, so that's how it is.
So right now your love is one-sided.
Tell me, {a}...
The person you like must be someone wonderful.{p}If you don't mind... won't you tell me that person's name?
Actually......
...It's a secret

"Actually......"
...Should I just say it?{p}

"Actually...?"
Iwashita was gazing at me with a smile.
"Actually, the one I like is......
you, Iwashita!"{p}

...Oh. Everyone was staring at me, their mouths hanging open.
'What a weird girl...'
That's what they seemed to be saying.
How mean. That was a sincere confession of love...
.................................................................. Nobody said a single word.
Iwashita just stared at me, without any expression.
...Is she appalled after all?
The moment that thought crossed my mind...{p}

Iwashita broke into a bright smile.
"Tell me, {a}...
Do you really mean that?{p}Can I... believe what you just said?"
I'm serious
Actually... I was joking

"Yes, of course I'm serious.
Please believe me."
I said it firmly.
Because I really do love her.
To think someone so attractive and wonderful had been at this school all along...
Today was the first time... I'd only just met her a little while ago, and yet my heart wouldn't stop pounding.
I'd meant to pour that feverish feeling into those few words, but...{p}

"...I see."
Iwashita lowered her eyes.
And then...
"...I'm sorry.
I can't return your feelings."
She murmured it briefly, in a small voice.
...It looked like my feelings hadn't reached her after all.{p}

"But don't get the wrong idea.
It isn't because I dislike you, {a}.
There's a deep reason behind this...
I'll tell you about it."
Iwashita took one deep breath, then began to speak, haltingly.{p}

Iwashita sat perfectly still, barely breathing.
...Is she angry?
I did say something weird...
I like Iwashita, but that feeling is on a completely different level from romance.
"I see..."
Iwashita murmured briefly, then let out a sigh.
And then...{p}

"And here I got my hopes up for nothing.
I'd taken a liking to you too, {a}..."
...Oh no, she really is angry.
She's kind of scary......
"...But I think it's better for you this way.
Because people who get close to me end up unhappy.{p}

Heh heh heh...
You probably can't believe it, hearing something like this so suddenly...
Yes, let me tell you the story."
With a meaningful smile, Iwashita began to speak, haltingly.{p}

"...It's a secret."
Turning bright red, that was the best answer I could manage.
The name of the person I like is top secret.
If I let it slip in a place like this, they'd tease me to no end.
"Oh my, {b}, you've gone all red!"
"Isn't that cute?
Such a natural reaction..."
Hearing them talk like that only made my face burn hotter.{p}

Seeing me like that, Iwashita giggled.
"My, {a}...
There's no need to be shy.
Heh heh heh heh...
I hope your feelings come true.
I hope that person becomes the best sweetheart you could ever have..."{p}

That was when strange things began to happen around me.
Because Yuya had come back to me...{p}

A boy who bumped into me in the hallway was sent flying five meters and slammed into the wall.
And our shoulders had barely even brushed.
The art club member who painted my portrait broke an arm...
The boy who lent me a book fell down the stairs and broke a bone.
One eerie accident after another kept happening around me.
Before long, nobody would come near me.
I was worn out, too, somehow...
Little by little, I came to live in fear of the voices and visions I saw and heard.
I'd grown terribly afraid of meeting people...{p}

...But even so, someone appeared who was kind to me.
A boy in my year...
What was his name again...?
He said he liked me...
That he was serious, so I should believe him...
He said it with an earnest face, too.
It was the first time anyone had said something like that to me since Yuya died.
I was happy...
Yuya would understand about this one.
Surely he would forgive me...
That's what I thought.
...But that was just my own selfish assumption.{p}

I mean, think about it.
There's no way he would die and leave me behind, when he loved me more than anyone.
He died because of me.
Yuya kept his promise and came back even after death, and then I had a change of heart, so Yuya got angry.
The accidents that had kept happening until then were all Yuya's doing, too.{p}
With that, Iwashita suddenly stood up.{p}

"{a}...
You said just now that you love me, didn't you?
Yuya is furious with you.
He says he won't forgive you, even if you are a girl..."
With a sorrowful smile, Iwashita walked toward me.
Then she suddenly thrust out both arms and seized me by the neck.
"Stop!"
"What are you doing★"
The startled members rushed in to stop her.
But even with three boys trying to hold her down, they were no match for her strength.
"I... Iwashi...ta...?"
Such incredible strength...
...This is no woman's strength!
"I'm sorry.
...There's nothing I can do."
With tears welling in her eyes, Iwashita tightened her arms around my throat.
"But let me say just one thing.
For telling someone like me that you love me.................................... thank you."
A single tear fell from Iwashita's eyes and wet my face.{p}
As my vision blurred, I saw a huge black shadow writhing behind Iwashita.{p}

<Ha ha ha...
This is what happens to anyone who lays a hand on my precious fiancée>
The shadow was laughing, its bright red mouth gaping open...{p}

...I see. So you're a weak person.
That's no good.
You have to become stronger...
Otherwise, you'll end up like me.
I used to be a weak person too...{p}

You can't believe it, you say?
No, you have to believe me!{p}

Listen.
If you don't want something horrible to happen to you, you'd better heed people's warnings.
You believe my story.
...Understand?
Now, nod for me.......... That's good.{p}

Spirits, you see, hate having their existence denied.
More than anyone, they want people to notice that they exist.
Yuya is the same.
Normally he wouldn't do anything to harm people, but...
If you deny his existence in a single word, calling him a 'dream' or an 'illusion,' he gets terribly angry.{p}

Heh heh heh...
Oh, {a}, you still look like you can't believe it.
But it's all right, isn't it?
After all, you nodded just now to say you believe me.{p}

"Um...
Would someone please take a look for me...?"
"All right, I'll go."
